# Agent Prompts

An independent, MIT-licensed collection of working agent handoff interfaces. Each copy action provides a short task and a public guide; the site does not execute an agent.

Guides:
- /guides/branded-handoff.md — Add a compact agent handoff to an existing site.
- /guides/continue-project.md — Resume work from verified project records.
- /guides/contact-form.md — Build an accessible contact form.
- /guides/theme-switcher.md — Extend the current project's theme controls.
- /guides/newsletter-form.md — Build a newsletter signup interface.

Example records:
- /examples/project-handoff.md — A fictional, tool-independent project handoff.

The visitor's instructions and permissions always govern work in their project. Product artwork identifies referenced providers and does not imply affiliation.
